liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): The Row Jimmy performance is highlighted as exceptional, almost too much [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-06-30.sbd.sbvol9.chappell.29753.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 170 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals are clear, crowd level is appropriate, and instruments sound good but not overly crisp; The matrix mix is balanced, superior to soundboard alone, and the band sounds superb; The Dark Star jam is very sweet, with good bass and balance on the soundboard [11][12][14][16][20]
- **gd1973-06-30.sbd.baker.19903.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: The source includes audience patches, notably for the beautiful Bird Song in set one [21]
- **gd1973-06-30.aud.weiner.100346.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 176 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [5]
- **gd1973-06-30.aud.sirmick.85816.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 177 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: The taper cleaned up the audience recording well, making it sound better than most others [17]
- **gd1973-06-30.aud.weiner.99703.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [7]. Said about its sound: The audience tape is rough in spots but the show itself is terrific; The tape is a washed-out nth generation, but the band is having too much fun [13][19]

## Around the show

- A total solar eclipse occurred, though it was not total at the time of the show [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-06-30.sbd.sbvol9.chappell.29753.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix Mix [1]. Also: Matrix uses LMA SBD and audience sources, with vocals slightly hot but good amphitheater echo [1]
- **gd1973-06-30.sbd.baker.19903.shnf**: transferred by J.D. Baker; source: This is a patched and re-tracked version of the previously circulating soundboard source shnid = 177 [2]. Also: Baker source combines Matt Z. audience and Chris K. soundboard, processed in Sound Forge and Vegas [2]
- **gd1973-06-30.aud.weiner.100346.flac16**: transferred by Noah Weiner and Matt Smith; source: Aud -> Master Reel [5]. Also: Will Boswell dubbed the reel in 1979 from Jerry Garcia's personal collection master tape [5]
- **gd1973-06-30.aud.sirmick.85816.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Audience > Reel [6]
- **gd1973-06-30.aud.weiner.99703.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Aud > MR > ? [7]
